title: An upload over its route limit never reaches the sandbox
drive: Coded in plugin-hostile.test.ts: 6 000 000 bytes to PUT /capture, 20 MB sent chunked with no Content-Length to PUT /capture, and 11 MB to PUT /big (maxBody 50 000 000) all get 413; then GET /reached answers 0. A false Content-Length frames the body at that length (HTTP), so the bytes past it never belong to the request.
